Corporate Tax & Accounting Services for Toronto Businesses

Real, practitioner-level CPA expertise for incorporated businesses, professionals, and small corporations across Toronto — built around CRA filing deadlines, the schedules and elections that govern your T2 return, and the compliance details that keep your corporation off the CRA's review list.

1

Corporate Tax Filing in Toronto

  • We file your T2 return within six months of fiscal year-end and remit any balance within two months — three months where the small business deduction applies — so Toronto corporations avoid the 5% late-filing penalty plus 1% per month of the unpaid balance.
  • We reconcile accounting net income to taxable income on Schedule 1, adding back non-deductible items such as 50% of meals, club dues, and accounting reserves that the CRA disallows on a corporate tax return.
  • We map your financials to the correct GIFI codes on Schedules 100 and 125, because a corporate tax accountant in Toronto who mis-tags balance sheet items invites CRA matching queries.
  • We track capital additions by CCA class on Schedule 8, apply the half-year rule, and claim immediate expensing on eligible property up to the $1.5M annual limit.
  • We calculate monthly or quarterly tax installments using the prior-year method to keep your corporation off the CRA's installment interest list at the prescribed rate.
2

Accounting & Bookkeeping in Toronto

  • We perform a monthly close with full bank reconciliation, clearing stale uncashed cheques and undeposited funds before they distort your general ledger.
  • We build a chart of accounts that separates GST/HST collected from input tax credits, so your return ties directly to the ledger with no manual back-tracing.
  • We age accounts receivable and accounts payable monthly, flagging balances past 90 days so bookkeeping services in Toronto translate into real cash-flow decisions.
  • We post shareholder draws to a dedicated due-to / due-from account, keeping personal and corporate transactions separated for clean year-end financial statements.
  • We retain source documents to satisfy the CRA's six-year books-and-records rule, so your Toronto business is audit-ready before any query arrives.
3

Corporate Tax Planning in Toronto

  • We design a salary-versus-dividend remuneration mix that balances RRSP room and CPP cost against the integration of dividend taxation for Toronto owner-managers.
  • We monitor the capital dividend account balance and file the T2054 election so capital gains can flow to shareholders tax-free.
  • We time the repayment of any shareholder loan before the end of the next fiscal year to avoid the full balance being added to personal income under subsection 15(2).
  • We track refundable dividend tax on hand (RDTOH) so dividends are paid in the year that recovers the refund rather than trapping it in the corporation.
  • We review associated-corporation status to confirm the $500,000 small business deduction limit is allocated correctly, since corporate tax planning in Toronto fails when passive-income grinds are missed.
4

Catch-Up Corporate Tax Filing in Toronto

  • We reconstruct several years of unfiled T2 returns from bank statements and merchant records when source books are missing, restoring Toronto corporations to CRA compliance.
  • We assess whether your overdue corporate tax returns qualify for the Voluntary Disclosures Program before the CRA contacts you, which can cancel penalties and partial interest.
  • We quantify accumulated CRA arrears, including compounding daily interest, so you see the true cost of outstanding filings before we file.
  • We confirm whether prior-year non-capital losses are still within the 20-year carry-forward window and apply them against catch-up year income.
  • We file in the correct chronological order so each Notice of Assessment carries the right balances forward, preventing the CRA from issuing arbitrary subsection 152(7) assessments.
5

GST/HST Filing in Toronto

  • We confirm your assigned reporting period — annual, quarterly, or monthly — against the $1.5M and $6M threshold tests so your GST/HST return frequency matches CRA requirements.
  • We compare the Quick Method against full input tax credits to determine which produces lower net tax for your Toronto business before each filing.
  • We screen claimed input tax credits for valid supplier registration numbers, since the CRA disallows ITCs lacking compliant documentation under the Excise Tax Act.
  • We handle GST/HST registration the moment you cross the $30,000 small-supplier threshold over four consecutive quarters, avoiding back-dated remittance exposure.
  • We self-assess GST/HST on imported services and intangibles so your return captures liabilities the CRA frequently reassesses on Toronto importers.
6

Corporate Tax Cleanup in Toronto

  • We file amended T2 returns to correct prior-year adjustments such as overstated CCA or missed income, before the CRA spots the discrepancy itself.
  • We reconcile a shareholder loan account that has drifted across multiple years, separating genuine repayments from misposted draws to avoid a subsection 15(2) income inclusion.
  • We post bookkeeping corrections for transactions recorded in the wrong period, then restate the affected year-end financial statements to match the filed returns.
  • We respond to a CRA reassessment by tracing the adjustment to its source entry, so the corrected figure is defensible rather than simply accepted.
  • We correct prior GIFI mismatches and opening-balance errors that carry forward, because corporate tax cleanup in Toronto only holds if the comparatives finally agree.
7

CRA Audit Resolution Services in Toronto

  • We respond to a CRA audit query with organized supporting documentation indexed to each line item, so the auditor works from our file rather than assumptions.
  • We file a Notice of Objection within the 90-day deadline after a Notice of Reassessment to keep your appeal rights alive while we negotiate.
  • We act as your authorized representative for audit representation, meaning CRA correspondence routes through us and you stop fielding direct auditor calls.
  • We apply for taxpayer relief to cancel interest and penalties where delays were caused by CRA error or circumstances beyond your control under subsection 220(3.1).
  • We prepare the audit defence for common Toronto triggers such as unreported shareholder benefits and personal-use vehicle expenses before the auditor raises them.
8

CPA Compilation Report (Notice to Reader) in Toronto

  • We issue a Compilation Engagement report under CSRS 4200, the standard that replaced the old Notice to Reader for all year-end financial statements.
  • We attach the required note describing the basis of accounting, which lenders and the CRA now expect on every compliant compilation in Toronto.
  • We prepare GIFI-coded financial statements that tie directly to the T2 return, so the figures your bank reviews match the figures the CRA holds.
  • We compile management-prepared information into a lender-ready package for mortgage renewals and equipment financing common to Toronto operating companies.
  • We disclose the absence of assurance clearly, so investors and stakeholders relying on the compilation understand its scope under professional standards.
9

Incorporation Services in Toronto

  • We file your Articles of Incorporation federally or provincially and advise which registry fits a Toronto business operating across provincial lines.
  • We structure share classes from the outset so future dividend sprinkling, a holding company, or a section 85 rollover stays available without later reorganization cost.
  • We open your full set of CRA program accounts under one Business Number, including RC corporate, RP payroll, and RT GST/HST, so registrations are not missed.
  • We establish the minute book with directors' resolutions, share subscriptions, and registers, meeting the corporate record-keeping requirement Toronto founders often overlook.
  • We document a shareholder agreement framework at formation to govern share transfers and exits, since incorporation services in Toronto should prevent disputes, not just file forms.
10

Catch-Up Bookkeeping in Toronto

  • We reconstruct months or years of overdue bookkeeping by organizing bank statements, credit card transactions, invoices, and receipts into accurate financial records ready for CRA reporting.
  • We reconcile every bank, credit card, loan, and shareholder account so your books support corporate tax filing, GST/HST returns, and year-end financial statements without discrepancies.
  • We identify missing income, duplicate expenses, uncategorized transactions, and bookkeeping errors that could trigger CRA reviews or incorrect corporate tax calculations.
  • We update your QuickBooks, Xero, or other accounting software with properly classified transactions, ensuring reliable financial reporting and clean year-end books.
  • We prepare complete catch-up bookkeeping records that integrate seamlessly with your T2 corporate tax return, GST/HST filings, payroll records, and CPA compilation engagement.
11

US Corporation & LLC Tax Filing in Toronto

  • We prepare accurate US Corporation and LLC tax returns, including Form 1120 and partnership filings, ensuring compliance with IRS filing deadlines and reporting requirements.
  • We assist Canadian residents who own US businesses by coordinating cross-border tax reporting to minimize double taxation under the Canada–US Tax Treaty.
  • We reconcile bookkeeping records with US tax adjustments, depreciation schedules, and deductible business expenses before filing your federal tax return.
  • We identify filing obligations for foreign-owned US corporations and LLCs, helping businesses avoid IRS penalties for late or incomplete tax filings.
  • We coordinate US business tax filing with your Canadian corporate and personal tax returns, providing integrated cross-border tax planning and compliance support.
12

Voluntary Disclosure Program in Toronto

  • We evaluate whether your unreported income, overdue tax returns, GST/HST filings, or payroll obligations qualify for the CRA Voluntary Disclosures Program before the CRA contacts you.
  • We prepare a complete Voluntary Disclosure Program application with supporting calculations and documentation to maximize eligibility for penalty relief and reduced interest.
  • We calculate outstanding corporate taxes, GST/HST balances, payroll remittances, interest, and penalties so you understand your total tax exposure before disclosure.
  • We communicate directly with the CRA throughout the voluntary disclosure process, responding to requests and protecting your interests until the application is finalized.
  • We help businesses restore full CRA compliance by correcting past tax reporting errors while reducing the financial impact of penalties through the Voluntary Disclosures Program.
